report_name: AI Hacking Framework 'ARTEX' Linked to South Korean Bank Heists

attack_patterns.name: Active Scanning
attack_patterns.description: The ARTEX framework automates reconnaissance by intelligently scanning for and identifying vulnerable targets at scale.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
attack_patterns.description: ARTEX was described as being able to generate polymorphic scripts, such as PowerShell or Python, that change with each execution to evade signature-based detection.

attack_patterns.name: Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion
attack_patterns.description: The ARTEX framework reportedly incorporates execution guardrails to check if the target environment is a sandbox or analysis environment before deploying its main payload.

attack_patterns.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: The framework is used to deploy payloads, such as unsigned binaries, into non-standard directories on victim systems.

malware.name: ARTEX
malware.description: An AI-powered hacking framework implicated in cyberattacks against South Korean banks. It is designed to automate multiple stages of an attack, including reconnaissance, exploitation, and evasion.

infrastructure.name: ARTEX C2 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Publicly exposed server infrastructure used by the operators of the ARTEX framework for command and control and other attack stages.

indicators.name: ARTEX Obfuscated PowerShell Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: ARTEX Obfuscated PowerShell Execution
id: f1a2b3c4-d5e6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of highly obfuscated and randomized PowerShell scripts, a behavior associated with the ARTEX framework.
references:
  - https://example.com/ai-hacking-framework-artex-linked-to-south-korean-bank-breaches
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-08
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -e '
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -encodedcommand '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of highly obfuscated and randomized PowerShell scripts, a behavior associated with the ARTEX framework, as mentioned in the report's cyber observables.

indicators.name: ARTEX DGA-like C2 Communication
indicators.pattern:
title: ARTEX DGA-like C2 Communication
id: e2f3a4b5-c6d7-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to domains with high entropy, characteristic of the algorithmically generated domains (DGA) used by the ARTEX framework for C2 communication. This rule is a conceptual placeholder and may require a more advanced detection engine.
references:
  - https://example.com/ai-hacking-framework-artex-linked-to-south-korean-bank-breaches
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-08
tags:
  - attack.t1568.002
  - attack.command_and_control
level: medium
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|re: '^[a-z0-9]{20,}\.(com|net|org|ru)$'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects DNS queries to domains with high entropy, characteristic of the algorithmically generated domains (DGA) used by the ARTEX framework for C2 communication.

indicators.name: ARTEX Unsigned Payload Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: ARTEX Unsigned Payload Execution
id: d3e4f5a6-b7c8-4c9d-8e1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of unsigned binaries from non-standard user directories (e.g., temp, user profile), a common TTP for payloads dropped by frameworks like ARTEX.
references:
  - https://example.com/ai-hacking-framework-artex-linked-to-south-korean-bank-breaches
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-08
tags:
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Signed: 'false'
    Image|contains:
      - 'C:\Users\'
      - 'C:\ProgramData\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
  filter_legit:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\OneDrive.exe'
      - '\Teams.exe'
      - '\ms-teams.exe'
      - '\GitHubDesktop.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit
indicators.description: Detects the execution of unsigned binaries from non-standard user directories, a TTP associated with payloads dropped by frameworks like ARTEX.
